关键词: City First Bank of D.C., N.A.
主要内容: Broadway Financial Corp and CFBanc Corporation received regulatory approvals for the proposed merger of CFBanc into Broadway Financial Corp, with Broadway Financial Corp as the surviving corporation. The merger also includes the subsequent merger of Broadway Federal Bank, f.s.b., with City First Bank of D.C., N.A. City First Enterprises, Inc., the largest stockholder of CFBanc, received approval to acquire approximately 18.85% of Broadway Financial Corp’s voting common stock and indirectly acquire Broadway Federal Bank, f.s.b. Broadway Financial Corp announced its intention to file a registration statement on Form S-4 with the SEC, which will include a joint proxy statement and a prospectus related to the proposed business combination with City First. The filing aims to provide investors with important information about the transaction. Certain directors and executive officers of Broadway and City First may be participants in the proxy solicitation. The communication includes forward-looking statements, which involve risks and uncertainties. Investors are urged to review the registration statement, joint proxy/prospectus, and other relevant documents, which will be available on the SEC website and the company's website.
